task: Adversarial Kimi K3 audit of a bounded binding.json reader used in contained-executor reopen and final synchronous G15 transaction recheck. This patch fixes FIFO blocking and post-stat growth beyond 64KiB. Current grants, complete inventory and identity checks remain unchanged. Scope is only binding reader hardening; NOT whole GraphDelivery recovery authorization. Private journal parent directories and host/admin remain trusted; this does not solve parent directory TOCTOU or all-device/network-filesystem latency. Evaluate code and actual test quality, including mock guards preventing the test runner hanging. No tools/modifications.

evaluation_criteria.requirement: Reject FIFO without waiting for writer; actual bytes read never exceed 65537, including short reads or post-stat growth; close descriptor on success and failure.
Existing binding identity, canonical bytes, expected scope, inventory, grants and transactional proof checks remain intact; no settlement/release/replay introduced.
Tests cover initial reopen and final transaction plus exact boundary, short reads, read errors; distinguish real OS behavior from mocks and do not overclaim full graph proof.

deterministic_results.summary: 72 tests passed. Initial new tests against old code:4 failed/2 passed (66 unselected); failures include FIFO guard, short-read instrumentation and injected read error. Growth tests alone also reject in old code because a later read sees the oversized file; do not claim these two independently establish the byte cap.
